scope: Selected GS, CSAT, Essay and BPSC foundation resources. This library is a reading map, not a claim of complete coverage of every optional subject or exam requirement.
accessNote: PDFs and book archives open on the publisher’s website. Download there for personal study. Publisher files are not mirrored by Crack IAS.
editionNote: NCERT is updating its school textbooks. Older site notes are supplementary revision aids and may not match current chapter numbering. Grade 8 Social Science Part II is omitted following NCERT’s recall notice; consult NCERT for a replacement.

history.task: Build a timeline, locate places on a map, and explain one cause and one consequence for each major event.

geography.task: Pair each process with a labelled diagram and an Indian example. Practise rivers, soils and agriculture on an outline map.

polity.task: Compare institutions by composition, powers and accountability. Verify current provisions against official constitutional text.

economy.task: Explain each concept in your own words, then connect it to a Budget or Economic Survey table with its year and units.

science.task: Prioritise everyday applications, mechanisms and diagrams. Use senior-secondary books selectively for GS, rather than solving every specialist derivation.

environment.task: Draw food webs and nutrient cycles; connect a pressure on an ecosystem to its impact and a practical conservation response.

ethics.task: Define a value, give a public-service example, and apply it to a case using stakeholders, options, safeguards and a reasoned decision.

society.task: Organise each issue by causes, affected groups, evidence and policy responses. Separate an observation from a stereotype.

ir.task: Prepare a country brief with shared interests, disagreements, agreements and a map. Update it with official statements.

csat.task: Practise arithmetic and comprehension under a time limit and log errors. Add previous papers for reasoning; textbooks alone do not cover CSAT.

essay.task: Write an outline with a clear thesis, multiple perspectives and a counterargument. Practise introductions and conclusions without memorised essays.

security.task: Map threats, vulnerable groups, responsible institutions and preventive measures; use a recent Indian example.

bihar.task: Maintain district maps and a dated Bihar fact sheet. Compare state indicators with the national average using the same year and definition.

current.task: Map each issue to a syllabus topic, write a short explanation and solve related questions. Recheck dated facts before the exam.

resources.title: Vajiram & Ravi — study materials
resources.description: Publisher's resource directory for further reading and practice.
resources.readingTask: Choose a topic after completing its NCERT foundation, then test recall with previous questions.

resources.title: Vajiram — Prelims Quick Revision / Knockout
resources.description: Publisher's annual revision collection, including 2026 Knockout volumes. Follow the publisher's download steps; access requirements may apply.
resources.readingTask: Revise by subject and record why each eliminated option is wrong.

resources.title: Economic Survey 2025–26
resources.description: Official national economic assessment with chapter downloads and statistical tables.
resources.readingTask: Record the year and units for each statistic. Build short notes linking growth, jobs, investment and public policy.

resources.title: Economic Survey 2025–26 — Environment and climate change
resources.description: Chapter 10 of the official Economic Survey.
resources.readingTask: Compare adaptation and mitigation, then prepare one example of financing and one of implementation.

resources.title: Economic Survey 2025–26 — Agriculture and food management
resources.description: Chapter 6 of the official Economic Survey.
resources.readingTask: Build a farm-to-market diagram with production, storage, prices and food distribution; add a Bihar example.

resources.title: Second ARC reports — ethics, governance and administration
resources.description: Official Administrative Reforms Commission report collection. Recommendations are proposals, not automatically current law.
resources.readingTask: Read recommendations selectively; connect each to an administrative problem and a realistic implementation constraint.

resources.title: Constitution of India — official editions
resources.description: Official editions of the constitutional text. Check the edition date when studying amendments.
resources.readingTask: Read the relevant article alongside NCERT explanations and compare powers, exceptions and safeguards.

resources.title: Ministry of Home Affairs — annual reports
resources.description: Official annual reporting on home affairs, with downloadable reports.
resources.readingTask: Extract responsibilities, programmes and dated evidence for a security answer; distinguish achievements from remaining challenges.

resources.title: Bihar Finance Department — Economic Survey and Budget
resources.description: State department portal for Bihar's economic and fiscal publications.
resources.readingTask: Prepare a dated sheet of growth, sector shares, expenditure priorities and district comparisons.

resources.title: Bihar Data Lab — district and state indicators
resources.description: Official Bihar statistics portal for state and district comparisons.
resources.readingTask: Compare districts with matching reference years and definitions, then identify an explanatory geographical or economic factor.

resources.title: Ministry of External Affairs — official statements and updates
resources.description: Primary source for India's official foreign-policy statements.
resources.readingTask: Update country briefs with dated agreements and statements; separate official positions from your own analysis.

resources.title: ePathshala — multilingual NCERT textbooks
resources.description: Official alternative access point for NCERT digital textbooks.
resources.readingTask: Use the class and subject selection to find another edition or language when a chapter link has moved.
